name: get_account
title: Who is connected
description: The Grabient account this connection keeps color palettes and collections in: its name and username. It also says how many palettes it has saved, how many collections it keeps, and where its Saved page is.

name: search_palettes
title: Search palettes
description: Search Grabient's gallery of color palettes and gradients by color, mood, theme or brand colors, or browse its popular, rising, newest and hot ones. `query` takes words in any language, hex codes, or a palette's seed or address for palettes like it. `colors` takes up to 5 hex colors the palettes come near. With neither, `order` lists the gallery. `read` gives the `words` understood and the ones `notRead`, and `page` reads on to `total`.

query.description: Up to 100 characters of words or hex codes, or a palette's seed or address.

order.description: The gallery's order without query or colors. Default popular, the most liked first; rising, what gained likes lately; hot, what was liked lately, and new.

name: search_collections
title: Search collections
description: Search Grabient's public collections of color palettes and gradients by theme or use, or list the most popular. Each is an ordered list of up to 100 palettes with a title, a description and tags. `first` is the addresses of its first six, each in its view there.

query.description: Words: a theme, a use or a brand; left out, the most popular.

name: get_collection
title: Read a collection
description: Read one collection of color palettes and gradients in order, each palette with its colors and view. A public collection or one of the account's own, by its slug or its address. A palette it names is `named`, with any `description`. `total` counts its palettes, which `page` reads on.

limit.description: How many palettes a page, default 48.

name: compose_palette
title: Make a palette
description: Make color palettes and CSS gradients from 2 to 8 hex colors each, such as brand colors, in order. Each comes with its seed, its address, its colors and the CSS that draws it as Grabient does in the view given: `colors` are the bands a Swatches view draws, else the colors a gradient blends between. Steps left out show every color. Nothing is saved. Each color is held as its hex.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

name: adjust_palette
title: Change a palette
description: Change a color palette or gradient from its seed: lighter, darker, calmer, more vivid, warmer, cooler, reversed, or with fewer or more colors. Each of `variants` makes one new palette, its fields applied together, and `hold` keeps colors such as a brand color as they are. Nothing is saved. `from` is the palette asked about, and a `note` says what a change could not reach.

seed.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

lighten.description: -1 to 1: the share of the way to white, or below 0 to black.

chromaScale.description: 0 to 3, multiplying chroma: under 1 is calmer, over 1 more vivid.

colorCount.description: Resamples the palette to this many colors.

hold.description: Colors of the palette that stay as they are.

variants.description: The palettes to make from it.

name: inspect_palettes
title: Inspect palettes
description: Read color palettes in full, up to 12: each color's hex, its name and its WCAG 2 contrast on white and on black, with the CSS. Each is read in the view given, else the one Grabient shows it in: the colors of a Swatches view are its bands, and of a gradient the ones it blends between. `gallery` is null for a palette the gallery lacks, and `collections` are the public ones that hold it.

seed.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

palettes.description: The palettes, each in the view to read it in.

name: show_palettes
title: Show palettes
description: Show color palettes and gradients side by side as numbered tiles, up to 24, each in the view given, else the one Grabient shows it in. One palette may come in several views. An app that draws Grabient's view shows each with its colors, and copies its address, CSS, SVG or PNG in full screen; in any other, each tile has `png`, its picture's address. `own` marks a title given or written for the palette on Grabient; any other names its colors.

name.description: The set's name, 1 to 80 characters: the title of a collection saved from it.

seed.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

name: list_saved_palettes
title: Saved palettes
description: The color palettes and gradients saved to the Grabient account, newest first, each in the view it was saved in. `total` counts them all, and `next` reads on from the last. `named` marks a title the account gave; any other is its title on Grabient. `savedPage` is the page that lists them.

after.description: The `next` of the answer before, to read on from it.

name: save_palette
title: Save a palette
description: Save a color palette or gradient to the Grabient account in the view given, else the one Grabient shows it in, or take it out with `saved` false. The first save of a palette new to Grabient adds it to the public gallery, where anyone can find it, without the account's name: `published` says so. A palette saved before keeps its first view. `title` is the account's own name for it, shown to nobody else.

seed.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

title.description: The account's name for it. A new one renames it; left out, its name stays.

saved.description: False takes it out of the saved palettes. Default true.

name: list_my_collections
title: My collections
description: The Grabient account's own collections of color palettes and gradients, latest change first, each with its `visibility`: only the account sees a private one, and everyone a public one. An account keeps up to 200.

name: save_collection
title: Make or change a collection
description: Make a private collection of color palettes, such as a brand's colors or a theme's gradients, or change one of the account's own, which everyone sees at once when it is public. Without a slug it makes one from a title and 1 to 100 palettes. With a slug a field given replaces what is there: `palettes` the whole list in order. `remove` takes palettes out and `add` puts them at the end. A palette may carry its own `title` and `description` here.

slug.description: The collection to change, by its slug or address; left out, a new one is made.

items.description: 2 to 32 letters, digits, spaces or hyphens.

tags.description: Up to 12 tags, replacing the ones it has.

seed.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

title.description: Its title here. "" takes it away.

description.description: What is said of it here. "" takes it away.

palettes.description: The whole list, in order. A palette named without a view keeps the one it has here, else the one Grabient shows it in.

seed.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

style.description: A gradient or hard bands: linear, angular or radial.

steps.description: How many colors the view draws.

title.description: Its title here. "" takes it away.

description.description: What is said of it here. "" takes it away.

add.description: Palettes to add at the end; one already here takes the words given. A palette named without a view keeps the one it has here, else the one Grabient shows it in.

items.description: A palette's seed, or its address, which carries its view.

remove.description: Palettes to take out: a seed in every view it has here, an address in the view it names.

name: delete_collection
title: Delete a collection
description: Delete one of the Grabient account's own collections of color palettes, a public one from the site too. Its palettes stay wherever else they are. This cannot be undone.
